name: rescan
setup: mkdir -p /content/work && tar -xzf /content/rescan_code.tgz -C /content/work && tar -xzf /content/rescan_data.tgz -C /content/work && pip install -q rapidfuzz && python -c "import os; from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; t = open('/content/.hf_token').read().strip() if os.path.exists('/content/.hf_token') else None; [snapshot_download(r, repo_type='dataset', cache_dir='/content/hf/hub', token=t) for r in ['aamijar/muharaf-public', 'calfa-ai/RASAM-1', 'calfa-ai/RASAM-2', 'calfa-ai/tarima', 'Teklia/KHATT_v1.0', 'U4RASD/omar-al-saleh-manuscripts-segments', 'calfa-ai/baybars', 'calfa-ai/iskandar', 'calfa-ai/AMIDDA']]"

runs.label: rescan
runs.cmd: cd /content/work/tadqiq && TADQIQ_HUB=/content/hf/hub TADQIQ_MAIN=/content/work PYTHONPATH=src python -u scripts/rescan_all.py --datasets muharaf-public RASAM-1 RASAM-2 tarima KHATT_v1.0 omar-al-saleh-manuscripts-segments baybars iskandar AMIDDA
